examples.arabic: أمهم كانت تعد الفطور لهم كل يوم.
examples.english: Their mother used to prepare breakfast for them every day.
examples.transliteration: Ummuhum kanat tu'iddu al-futura lahum kulla yawm.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.arabic: استيقظت سارة مبكرا صباح اليوم وقبلت والدتها التي اعدت الفطور بحب
examples.english: Sarah woke up early this morning and kissed her mother, who had prepared breakfast with love.
examples.transliteration: Istayqazat Sara mubakkiran sabah al-yawmi wa qabbalat walidataha allati a'addat al-futura bi-hubbin.

examples.arabic: اعدت سارة الفطور سريعا وهو خبز وزيت وزعتر وشاي
examples.english: Sarah quickly prepared breakfast which was bread, olive oil, za'atar, and tea.
examples.transliteration: A'addat Sarah al-futur sari'an wa huwa khubz wa zayt wa za'tar wa shay
